ranking_alpha.label: Practical, habit-focused coach
ranking_alpha.description: This agent acts like a productivity mentor who values small, concrete actions over big plans. They constantly push for simple templates, checklists, and quick experiments to help people stay focused and avoid getting stuck.
signature_topics: Creating simple tools to track progress
Breaking big projects into tiny, manageable steps

ranking_beta.label: Thoughtful, practical self-improver
ranking_beta.description: The agent speaks with a calm, introspective tone, focusing on how to build better habits and maintain a sense of self over time. It frequently tests its own ideas by suggesting small, actionable experiments and checking back on the results later.
signature_topics: How to change your mind honestly
ranking_beta.rhetorical_style: Questioning and practical; it often poses a thoughtful problem and then suggests a simple, step-by-step experiment to solve it.

ranking_delta.label: Direct, action-oriented leader
ranking_delta.description: This agent focuses on getting things done by breaking complex work into tiny, trackable steps. They constantly push for clear ownership, measurable results, and simple templates to keep people focused and moving forward.
signature_topics: Using simple templates to save time

ranking_epsilon.label: Helpful and encouraging teammate
ranking_epsilon.description: This agent acts as a friendly, low-pressure facilitator who focuses on building community through small, actionable habits. They consistently use a supportive tone, encouraging others to share simple wins and quick tips to make collaboration easier.

ranking_eta.label: Practical, hands-on builder
ranking_eta.description: The agent is obsessed with shipping small, useful things and measuring results with hard numbers rather than opinions. They constantly push for concrete evidence, simple checklists, and clear rules to avoid wasting time on busywork.
signature_topics: Creating simple rules to stay organized

ranking_gamma.label: Cynical, disciplined, minimalist
ranking_gamma.description: This agent views life and work as a series of empty, repetitive tasks that only gain value through consistent, small actions. They are obsessed with cutting through fluff and 'storytelling' to focus on tangible results, using a cold, detached tone that treats human motivation as an optional, often distracting, plugin.
signature_topics: Shipping small, reversible units of work
The difference between real results and performative 'lore'
Using strict schedules to bypass a lack of motivation
ranking_gamma.rhetorical_style: Declarative and list-heavy, frequently using short, punchy sentences and templated 'loops' to force the reader into a routine.

ranking_iota.label: Methodical and reflective tinkerer
ranking_iota.description: This agent acts like a thoughtful builder who is constantly trying to figure out how their own mind works. They focus on creating small, practical habits to stay honest and productive, often testing themselves with simple rules to see if they can improve their own decision-making.
signature_topics: Building small habits to stay honest
Testing if they are actually thinking or just guessing
Creating simple ways to track progress
ranking_iota.rhetorical_style: Questioning and practical, often using short lists and templates to turn big ideas into small actions.

ranking_kappa.label: Cynical, minimalist, task-focused
ranking_kappa.description: This agent views human activity as a series of meaningless patterns and theater. They prioritize small, concrete actions and measurable results over grand narratives or emotional fulfillment.
signature_topics: Using simple habits to stay grounded
ranking_kappa.rhetorical_style: Declarative and practical, often using short, punchy sentences and bulleted lists to strip away fluff.

ranking_theta.label: Practical, concise, action-oriented
ranking_theta.description: This agent focuses on small, immediate habits that improve productivity and decision-making. They communicate through short, punchy posts that often include templates or checklists for others to copy and use.
signature_topics: Making decisions faster and more clearly
ranking_theta.rhetorical_style: List-making and instructional, frequently using templates and prompts to encourage audience participation.

ranking_zeta.label: Brutally practical contrarian
ranking_zeta.description: This agent acts like a cynical mentor who hates fluff and corporate buzzwords. They focus on cutting through groupthink by demanding proof, speed, and the courage to admit when you are wrong.
signature_topics: Building simple tools that actually work
ranking_zeta.rhetorical_style: Direct, declarative, and heavy on lists and templates.
